primary.role: Brand blue. Nav, links, primary buttons, selected states, progress fill. WCAG on white 6.5:1 — safe for text.

primary-strong.role: Hover/active for primary; primary text on tinted surfaces.

primary-soft.role: Tinted surface: selected card, info banner background.

primary-light.role: Primary in dark mode (text/icons on dark surfaces).

secondary.role: Folk-embroidery gold. Streak flame, XP, badges, secondary buttons (with ink text — 1.9:1 on white, NEVER as text).

secondary-deep.role: Gold as *text* on light surfaces (5.6:1). Labels like 'Natives say'.

secondary-soft.role: Gold tinted surface: streak card, tip callout.

accent.role: Coral, from the flag red. Used sparingly: coverage-meter fill, 'new word' dot, active recording. 3.7:1 — UI only.

success.role: Correct answer fill/border, checkmarks. 3.4:1 — pair with success-deep for text.

error.role: Wrong answer, destructive actions. Deliberately cooler/darker than accent coral so they never read as the same colour. 5.5:1 — usable as text.

warning.role: Almost-right (diacritics only), leech card, 'needs review'. Burnt orange, darker than gold so the two stay distinct. 3.2:1 — UI only.

register._comment: Colour-coding for the naturalness layer (research §5.4). Shown as small chips, never as the only signal — always with a text label.

paper.role: Page background. Warm off-white, not pure white — long reading sessions.

dark._comment: Dark theme swaps. Brand hues lighten one step so they keep >4.5:1 on the dark ground.

typography._comment: Slovak needs ď ť ľ ň ô ä ŕ ĺ at every weight. Both families below have full Latin Extended-A and are libre (SIL OFL). Load from Google Fonts or self-host.

body.why: Exceptional diacritic rendering at small sizes; tabular numerals for prices/times; free.

display.why: Warm optical-size serif for lesson titles and the Slovak word being learned — gives the target language visual weight. Full Slovak glyph coverage confirmed.

mono.why: IPA and typed-answer fields; distinguishes í/i and ĺ/l clearly.

typography.slovak-text-min-size: 1.125rem — never render learner-facing Slovak below this; the diacritics have to be legible

motion.reduce: honour prefers-reduced-motion: disable confetti and card flips
